title: Vero Beach man arrested in explicit deepfake investigation; police fear more victims

reports.title: Vero Beach man arrested in explicit deepfake investigation; police fear more victims

summary:
Peter Solomon Ruma, 37, of Vero Beach was arrested and held on a $1 million bond after police say he created and shared AI generated sexually explicit images of women without consent. He allegedly took photos from social media and other online sources to make the altered images. A search of his home and devices on Wednesday found evidence linking him to the images. He faces eight charges involving one victim from June through August 2026, including three counts of creating altered sexual depictions, three counts of promoting them, one count of sexual cyber harassment, and one count of stalking.

Police have identified several other possible victims who may not know images of them were made or shared, and they believe Ruma may have done this for years. The investigation is ongoing and additional charges could be filed. Authorities are asking anyone who believes they were victimized or has information about the images to contact the Vero Beach Police Department.
